This notebook describes the analysis inputs and validates their schemas and file identities. Figure notebooks use the saved numerical tables and fitted objects supplied with this analysis. The methods notebooks in `pipeline/` document upstream procedures with computationally intensive steps disabled by default.

`provenance/source_tables.json` records each table, its source and its data definition. Original histology measurement grids retain their complete layout in `data/raw_sheets/`; mouse identifiers distinguish biological samples from sections and hemispheres.

## Inputs and saved objects

Paths are relative to the `CortexCode/` directory. **saved-results** inputs support routine rendering; **optional-rerun** inputs are read only when the corresponding analysis is enabled. Wildcards identify file collections.

| Mode | Input path | Use |
|---|---|---|
| saved-results | `provenance/source_tables.json` | Schema and provenance for numerical source tables |
| saved-results | `provenance/copied_files.json` | Original saved-input copy identities; notebook 00 audits every listed file for presence and size |
| saved-results | `data/source_tables/**/*.csv` | Complete source-table release validated by notebook 00 |
| saved-results | `data/raw_sheets/**/*.csv` | Complete original measurement-grid release |

See [input locations](INPUTS.md), [saved R objects](SAVED_OBJECTS.md) and the [complete file inventory](config/file_inventory.csv) for original source names, sizes and availability. These large inputs are not part of the Git checkout.

## Validate bundled tables

Load each standardized table into a figure-specific RDS checkpoint. Preserve irregular histology grids separately.

```{r validate-bundled-tables-2}
schema <- jsonlite::fromJSON(
  file.path(REPO, "provenance/source_tables.json"),
  simplifyVector = FALSE
)
for (book in unique(
  vapply(
    schema, `[[`, character(1),
    "book"
  )
)) {
  entries <- Filter(
    function(s) s$book ==
      book, schema
  )
  tables <- list()
  for (s in entries) {
    f <- file.path(REPO, s$file)
    stopifnot(file.exists(f))
    x <- if (!is.null(s$layout))
      read.csv(
        f,
        header = FALSE,
        colClasses = "character",
        na.strings = "",

        fill = TRUE
      ) else read.csv(f,
        check.names = FALSE,
        na.strings = c("", "NA"))
    stopifnot(
      nrow(x) ==
        s$rows
    )
    tables[[s$sheet]] <- x
  }
  save_object(tables, paste0("source_tables/", book))
}
cat(
  length(schema),
  "tables validated and saved as figure-specific RDS objects.\n"
)
```

## Input integrity

Check the copied upstream objects against their recorded SHA-256 checksums. Full 2.3 GB cache hashing is opt-in because it adds I/O and does not alter any data.

```{r input-integrity-3}
manifest <- jsonlite::fromJSON(file.path(REPO, "provenance/copied_files.json"))
stopifnot(all(file.exists(file.path(REPO, manifest$file))))
stopifnot(
  all(
    file.info(file.path(REPO, manifest$file), extra_cols = FALSE)$size ==
      manifest$bytes
  )
)
if (identical(
  Sys.getenv("CORTEX_VERIFY_HASHES"),
  "true"
)) {
  stopifnot(requireNamespace("digest", quietly = TRUE))
  observed <- vapply(
    file.path(REPO, manifest$file),
    digest::digest, character(1),
    algo = "sha256",
    file = TRUE
  )
  stopifnot(
    identical(
      unname(observed),
      manifest$sha256
    )
  )
}
write.csv(
  manifest, file.path(REPO, "reports/input_manifest.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
